unit: A method recipe, not an independently replicated result or a universally superior successor.
alias_note: Historical directory method1 maps to M2_free; method2 maps to M1_cooperative. Use config method semantics, not directory digits.

methods.one_line_zh: 同一优化会话，每轮协调修改至少两个启用插件。
methods.one_line_en: One persistent optimizer edits at least two active plugins per round.
methods.change_zh: 限制每轮至少两个实质变更，并逐轮记录六层复盘。
methods.change_en: Require at least two substantive changes and a six-layer round review.
methods.rule_zh: 同批训练均值严格提高，且修改插件有实际输入或控制记录，才有采用资格。
methods.rule_en: Require a strict same-batch training mean gain and observed input/control use of changed plugins.
methods.inputs_zh: 父版、同批训练轨迹、既定接口与当前进度。
methods.inputs_en: Parent, current-batch training traces, fixed interfaces and progress.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 磁盘早期 method2／luna_multi 对应本方法；协同指插件协同，不是多个优化器。通用运行器并不自动恢复原二十轮提示、起点和全部环境。
methods.limitations_en: Historical method2 / luna_multi maps here. Coordination means plugin coordination, not multiple optimizers. The common runner alone does not reproduce original prompts, starts or environments.

methods.one_line_zh: 单一持续会话自由选择新增、修改、删除或组合插件。
methods.one_line_en: One persistent optimizer freely adds, edits, removes or combines plugins.
methods.change_zh: 不设插件数量配额，保留同批比较及真实使用条件。
methods.change_en: Remove a plugin-count quota while retaining paired-batch evaluation and use evidence.
methods.rule_zh: 同批训练均值严格提高，且变更插件实际进入输入或控制路径。
methods.rule_en: Require a strict same-batch training mean gain and observed use of changed plugins.
methods.inputs_zh: 与方法一相同的任务批次与基线，逐组隔离训练材料。
methods.inputs_en: The same task batches and baseline as M1, with per-arm training materials isolated.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 磁盘早期 method1／astra_autonomous 对应本方法。两路线ALFWorld的Sol已选版均为95.41%；不能由此推广到所有场景。
methods.limitations_en: Historical method1 / astra_autonomous maps here. Selected Sol artifacts from both routes reached 95.41% on ALFWorld; this does not establish universal superiority.

methods.label_zh: 原始 Astra：已有插件起点
methods.one_line_zh: 持续会话接续已有 V1／V2 能力，自由改插件。
methods.one_line_en: A persistent session continues from existing V1/V2 capabilities.
methods.change_zh: 真实业务回执驱动有界动作检查与恢复；没有固定插件配额。
methods.change_en: Use actual business receipts for bounded action checks and recovery; no fixed plugin quota.
methods.rule_zh: 按完整训练成绩选择下一父版；历史测试测量不作为选版规则。
methods.rule_en: Select the next parent using complete training scores; historical test measurements do not define selection.
methods.inputs_zh: 已有V1／V2代码与训练证据；Telecom双角色运行协议。
methods.inputs_en: V1/V2 code and training evidence under the Telecom two-role protocol.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 读取当前父版与失败
选择一个具体机制并实现
完整训练后保留更好父版
steps_en: Read the current parent and failures
Implement a concrete mechanism
Keep the better parent after full training
methods.final_selection_en: Training selects V4: 174/222; original test 96/120 (80.00%).
methods.limitations_zh: 不是从空插件出发。后来的配对干预测量95/120与原96/120是不同测量；公开统一入口未复刻这套历史控制器。
methods.limitations_en: This is not an empty-plugin start. A later paired intervention measured 95/120; it is separate from the original 96/120. The public unified entry point does not reconstruct this historical controller.

methods.one_line_zh: 从空插件起点出发，持续会话进化二十个候选。
methods.one_line_en: Evolve 20 candidates from empty plugins in one persistent session.
methods.change_zh: 每轮至少两个启用插件发生实质变化，并保留六层复盘。
methods.change_en: Require two substantive active-plugin edits per round and retain the six-layer review.
methods.rule_zh: 完整74题×3训练严格提高才接续；测试不指导下一轮。
methods.rule_en: Continue only after a strict full 74-task × 3 training gain; test does not guide the next round.
methods.inputs_zh: 空插件起点、训练轨迹、同一优化会话。
methods.inputs_en: Empty-plugin start, training traces and the same optimizer session.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 归因及提出协调修改
实现并核对六层记录
完整训练、采用决定、继续当前最佳
steps_en: Diagnose and propose coordinated changes
Implement and review the six layers
Run full training, decide and continue the current best
methods.limitations_zh: 与Astra同时不同模型、起点和编辑约束，不能解释成单独的模型能力差。历史配方尚未完整接入统一入口。
methods.limitations_en: Model, startpoint and editing constraints all differ from Astra; this is not an isolated model comparison. The historical recipe is not fully ported to the unified entry point.

methods.one_line_zh: 给优化器更具体的钩子能力、状态和实现指导。
methods.one_line_en: Give the optimizer explicit hook, state and implementation guidance.
methods.change_zh: 改变提案前的指导，不把Playbook当执行时插件。
methods.change_en: Change proposal guidance; the Playbook itself is not a runtime plugin.
methods.rule_zh: 保留各原生实例训练采用规则，按本实例预算结束。
methods.rule_en: Retain each native campaign’s training adoption rule and configured budget.
methods.inputs_zh: 当前代码、训练证据、DSH能力指导；起点分H0与已有插件。
methods.inputs_en: Current code, training evidence and DSH guidance; starts include H0 and existing plugins.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: Telecom H0 Sol为77.50%；OS一个训练大幅上升的分支测试30.79%。指导更详细未带来跨场景一致收益；历史提示尚未全部移植。
methods.limitations_en: Telecom H0 Sol reached 77.50%; an OS branch with large training gains tested at 30.79%. More detailed guidance did not yield consistent cross-benchmark gains; historical prompts are not fully ported.

methods.one_line_zh: 训练变好，开发验证也不能变差。
methods.one_line_en: Training must improve without development-validation regression.
methods.change_zh: 在同批训练晋升上增加固定验证集非退步条件。
methods.change_en: Add validation non-regression to the paired-batch training gate.
methods.rule_zh: 当前冠军为父版；训练均值严格提高、验证均值不降、变更插件实际使用。
methods.rule_en: Parent must be the champion; require training mean gain, non-decreasing validation mean and changed-plugin use.
methods.inputs_zh: 当前冠军、训练批次、固定开发验证集。
methods.inputs_en: Current champion, training batch and fixed development-validation set.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 反复使用同一小验证集仍可能过拟合；三场景四十轮，历史Telecom二十轮另列。
methods.limitations_en: Repeated use of a small validation set can still overfit; the three-benchmark 40-round campaigns are separate from historical 20-round Telecom runs.

methods.one_line_zh: 在L1上保护一小组预先选定的训练任务。
methods.one_line_en: Protect a preselected subset of training tasks on top of L1.
methods.change_zh: 增加机制假设及固定任务子集回放。
methods.change_en: Add a mechanism hypothesis and fixed task-subset replay.
methods.rule_zh: L1全部条件，加回放子集分数总和不下降。
methods.rule_en: All L1 conditions, plus non-decreasing replay-subset score sum.
methods.inputs_zh: L1输入，加replay-ids.json所选任务。
methods.inputs_en: L1 inputs plus the tasks selected by replay-ids.json.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 实际代码并非动态只回放父版成功题；总分非退步仍可由新修复抵消旧退步。
methods.limitations_en: The implementation does not dynamically choose only parent-success tasks. Aggregate non-regression can conceal regressions offset by repairs.

methods.one_line_zh: 分开管理可探索分支与当前冠军。
methods.one_line_en: Manage exploration branches separately from the current champion.
methods.change_zh: 保留最多三个验证较好的候选，从最少访问分支继续。
methods.change_en: Retain up to three high-validation candidates and continue the least-visited branch.
methods.rule_zh: 变更实际使用且验证不低于归档最低值（未满三项则可入档）；仅验证严格超过冠军才换冠军。
methods.rule_en: Require observed changed-plugin use and validation at least the archive minimum (or a free slot). Replace the champion only on strict validation improvement.
methods.inputs_zh: 分支归档、使用次数、当前批次与固定验证。
methods.inputs_en: Branch archive, visit counts, current batch and fixed validation.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 选最少访问父版，同次数优先更高验证
执行共同候选流程
分别记录分支保留和冠军变化
steps_en: Choose the least-visited parent; break ties by higher validation
Execute the common candidate loop
Record archive retention and champion changes separately
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 不要求每次入档都训练提升；已有分支归档不等于按机制互补保留的Archive方案。
methods.limitations_en: Archive admission need not improve training. This score-based archive is not the proposed mechanism-complementary archive.

methods.one_line_zh: 先说明已有插件各管什么，再提出改动。
methods.one_line_en: Explain existing plugin responsibilities before proposing an edit.
methods.change_zh: 候选生成前维护能力、状态、重叠、冲突和缺口。
methods.change_en: Maintain capabilities, state, overlap, conflicts and gaps before proposal.
methods.rule_zh: 当前冠军为父版；训练均值严格提高且变更实际使用。仅在配置了独立验证时才要求其均值不降。
methods.rule_en: Use the current champion; require training mean gain and observed changed-plugin use. Require validation non-regression only when independent validation is configured.
methods.inputs_zh: 当前源码、启用插件、当前训练批次；独立验证是否存在以实例配置为准。
methods.inputs_en: Current source, active plugins and training batch; whether an independent validation set exists is instance-specific.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 维护agent-state.md和proposal.md
实施最小必要插件改动
同批训练和验证后决定
steps_en: Update agent-state.md and proposal.md
Implement the necessary plugin edits
Decide after paired-batch training and validation
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: DB结果较强，但不是能力图的独立消融。L4 H0的DB/Web为300训练（6×50），无独立验证；不能概括成L4统一带验证门槛。
methods.limitations_en: The strong DB result is not an isolated capability-map ablation. L4 H0 DB/Web use 300 training tasks (6x50) without independent validation; L4 is not universally validation-gated.

methods.one_line_zh: 从旧训练选定产物继续L4。
methods.one_line_en: Continue L4 from an earlier training-selected artifact.
methods.change_zh: 改变起点，L4机制不变。
methods.change_en: Change the startpoint while retaining L4.
methods.rule_zh: 沿用L4门槛；基线必须是指定旧产物。
methods.rule_en: Use the L4 gate and the specified prior artifact as baseline.
methods.inputs_zh: L4输入，加指定起点的完整插件与组合。
methods.inputs_en: L4 inputs plus the complete specified seed artifact.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 维护agent-state.md和proposal.md
实施最小必要插件改动
同批训练和验证后决定
steps_en: Update agent-state.md and proposal.md
Implement the necessary plugin edits
Decide after paired-batch training and validation
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 高起点未稳定提高最终测试；初始化时不能用空插件偷偷代替旧起点。
methods.limitations_en: A stronger start did not consistently improve final tests; initialization must not substitute empty plugins for the required seed.

methods.one_line_zh: 增加搜索预算，保留旧方法与训练选定起点。
methods.one_line_en: Extend the search budget while retaining the original method and training-selected start.
methods.change_zh: 区分起点与额外搜索预算，不新增能力图要求。
methods.change_en: Separate seed and extra-budget effects without adding a capability-map requirement.
methods.rule_zh: 以对应Resume实例的训练/验证门槛为准；不能自动视作L4。
methods.rule_en: Use the corresponding Resume instance’s training/validation gate; do not relabel it L4.
methods.inputs_zh: 旧训练选定产物、原方法定义与后续训练材料。
methods.inputs_en: Prior training-selected artifact, original method definition and subsequent training materials.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: Web最终v36为44.33%；事后测试v12为47.00%，两者必须分开。
methods.limitations_en: Web final v36 tested at 44.33%; retrospective v12 tested at 47.00%. Keep both measurements and selection roles distinct.

methods.one_line_zh: 数据库跨批检查、购物严格成功、操作系统按类别验证。
methods.one_line_en: Check another DB batch, optimize strict shopping success and validate OS categories.
methods.change_zh: 继承L4能力梳理；调整各场景目标和门槛。
methods.change_en: Retain L4 capability review while changing benchmark objectives and gates.
methods.rule_zh: DB：L4加下一批不退步；Web：同批严格成功提高且验证严格成功不降；OS：L4加类别宏平均不降。
methods.rule_en: DB: L4 plus next-batch non-regression. Web: strict training-success gain and strict-validation non-regression. OS: L4 plus category-macro non-regression.
methods.inputs_zh: 当前能力图、训练与验证；DB另读下一批，OS包含任务类别映射。
methods.inputs_en: Capability map, training and validation; an extra DB batch and OS task-family map.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 维护能力和场景问题提案
按场景评分与验证逻辑评测
门槛满足才采用，预算结束后最终测试
steps_en: Maintain capabilities and the benchmark-specific proposal
Evaluate with the benchmark’s objective and validation logic
Accept only when gates hold; test the final selection after the budget
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 相较L4，L5的DB/Web采用240训练（6×40）加60验证，同时改变了数据划分和门槛。Web平均奖励下降但严格成功提高可以合法采用。
methods.limitations_en: Relative to L4, L5 DB/Web use 240 training tasks (6x40) plus 60 validation tasks, changing both partitions and gates. A Web candidate may be accepted when mean reward falls but strict success improves.

methods.one_line_zh: 先写可核对的失败簇、修复位置和预期行为。
methods.one_line_en: Record trace-backed failure clusters, repair locations and expected behavior before coding.
methods.change_zh: 把提案固定在实现之前，并统计成对修复/回退。
methods.change_en: Record the proposal before implementation and report paired repairs/regressions.
methods.rule_zh: 同批严格成功提高；变更必须在计划内且有实际使用/移除证据；不要求原目标簇至少修好一题。
methods.rule_en: Require paired-batch strict-success gain, planned edits and observed use/removal evidence; no rule requires a repaired task in the original target cluster.
methods.inputs_zh: 父版训练轨迹、插件状态、失败簇、成功对照。
methods.inputs_en: Parent training traces, plugin state, failure clusters and successful controls.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 准备候选并写analysis.json
plan冻结修复假设，再改插件
评测并核对目标修复、全体回退与采用门槛
steps_en: Prepare the candidate and write analysis.json
Record the repair hypothesis with plan, then edit plugins
Evaluate target repairs, global regressions and adoption eligibility
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 没有独立验证，使用300训练；没有完整继承L5。40次采用中11次未修好计划目标，总收益与解释命中必须分开。
methods.limitations_en: L6 uses 300 training tasks without independent validation and does not fully inherit L5. Eleven of 40 acceptances repaired none of their planned targets; total gains and explanation accuracy are separate.

methods.label_en: L7: failure coverage and benchmark validation
methods.one_line_zh: 检查全部失败索引，深读代表轨迹，恢复场景验证。
methods.one_line_en: Cover all failed-task IDs, inspect representative traces and add benchmark validation.
methods.change_zh: 在L6上约束失败覆盖，并加验证/下一批/类别宏平均门槛。
methods.change_en: Add failure-ID coverage and validation/next-batch/category gates to L6.
methods.rule_zh: L6条件加验证严格成功不降；DB下一批严格成功不降；OS类别宏平均不降。
methods.rule_en: L6 gates plus strict-validation non-regression; DB next-batch strict success and OS category macro must not regress.
methods.inputs_zh: L6输入，加完整失败索引、验证集与场景映射。
methods.inputs_en: L6 inputs plus the full failure index, validation set and benchmark mappings.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 所有失败编号归簇，允许未解决簇
执行L6计划、实现、评测
核对验证和场景门槛后决定
steps_en: Assign every failed-task ID to a cluster, allowing unresolved clusters
Execute L6 planning, implementation and evaluation
Apply validation and benchmark-specific gates before deciding
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 三场景为300训练加60验证，区别于L1-L3/L5的240加60。编号全覆盖不等于读完每条完整轨迹，也不是单变量变化。
methods.limitations_en: The three benchmarks use 300 training plus 60 validation tasks, unlike the 240+60 L1-L3/L5 setup. ID coverage is not full-trajectory reading, and this is not a one-variable change.

methods.one_line_zh: 每轮决定后独立学习，下一轮读取简短经验。
methods.one_line_en: Learn separately after each decision; provide concise experience to the next round.
methods.change_zh: 在L7上增加循环内经验更新，可保留、修订或删除旧经验。
methods.change_en: Add within-campaign experience updates to L7, retaining, revising or deleting prior lessons.
methods.rule_zh: 采用规则同L7；经验写出或送达不自动赋予采用资格。
methods.rule_en: Use L7 adoption rules; writing or delivering experience does not make a candidate eligible.
methods.inputs_zh: 上一版经验、计划、决定、实际结果、修复/退步/仍失败的训练例子。
methods.inputs_en: Prior experience, plan, decision, outcomes and training repair/regression/failure examples.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 按L7完成候选与决定
独立学习调用更新至多八条简短经验
下一候选说明哪些适用、不适用或需修订
steps_en: Complete the L7 candidate and decision
Use a separate learning call to update at most eight short lessons
Explain applicable, inapplicable or revisable lessons in the next proposal
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 120轮均生成并送入经验，但未稳定提高测试。经验调用增加资源成本，不能只统计候选次数。
methods.limitations_en: Experience was generated and passed forward for 120 rounds, without consistent test gains. Learning calls add resource cost beyond candidate counts.

methods.one_line_zh: 先总结旧训练活动，再固定指导一整次新搜索。
methods.one_line_en: Summarize prior training campaigns and hold that guidance fixed during a new search.
methods.change_zh: 把跨活动经验与本次插件起点分开。
methods.change_en: Separate prior-campaign knowledge from the current plugin startpoint.
methods.rule_zh: 采用规则同L7；本次结束后生成的经验只供下次活动，不回改本次结果。
methods.rule_en: Use L7 gates; experience written after completion is for a future campaign and does not alter this result.
methods.inputs_zh: 旧L4/L5训练材料与新的空插件起点；不向学习器提供测试分数。
methods.inputs_en: Prior L4/L5 training material and a fresh empty-plugin start; do not supply test scores to the learner.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 先独立提炼并固定外部经验
四十轮候选沿用该经验，按L7选择
结束后总结供下次活动的经验
steps_en: Extract and freeze prior-campaign experience
Reuse it through 40 rounds with L7 selection
Summarize the completed campaign for a future run
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 空插件不等于无先验；旧活动和总结成本必须计入资源比较，测试结果不稳定。
methods.limitations_en: Empty plugins do not imply no prior knowledge. Prior campaigns and summarization belong in the resource budget; test results are inconsistent.

methods.one_line_zh: 从当前失败出发，选择旧插件并检查组合关系。
methods.one_line_en: Select prior plugins from current failures and check their interactions.
methods.change_zh: 在L7上加入训练选定组件目录、导入、兼容与冲突分析。
methods.change_en: Add a catalog of training-selected components, import and compatibility/conflict analysis to L7.
methods.rule_zh: 采用规则同L7；组件导入前先列入修复计划，组装仍需实际评测。
methods.rule_en: Use L7 gates; plan component imports before assembly and evaluate the assembled candidate.
methods.inputs_zh: 旧训练选定产物和训练证据、当前失败；不使用组件测试分数排序。
methods.inputs_en: Prior training-selected artifacts and training evidence, plus current failures; do not rank parts by test scores.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 建立能力、共享状态与冲突目录
在修复计划中选组件并调用component导入
适配组合后评测，按L7决定
steps_en: Catalog capabilities, shared state and conflicts
Select parts in the repair plan and import them with component
Adapt and evaluate the assembly, then use L7 selection
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: L7—L9中较强但未全面超过L4/L5；组件来自旧搜索，资源不等于冷启动。继承的导入记录不等于新增独立组件数。
methods.limitations_en: Strongest among L7–L9 but not consistently beyond L4/L5. Components come from prior search, not a resource-free cold start. Inherited import logs are not counts of new unique parts.

methods.one_line_zh: 用普通简明摘要指导下一候选。
methods.one_line_en: Guide the next candidate with a concise ordinary summary.
methods.change_zh: 在原生候选边界增加训练证据反馈；候选执行前记录预测。
methods.change_en: Add training-evidence feedback at the native candidate boundary; record a prediction before candidate execution.
methods.rule_zh: 继承本场景原生采用规则，不把新反馈自动视为L7验证门槛；测试仅最终报告。
methods.rule_en: Retain the benchmark’s native adoption rule; feedback does not implicitly add L7 validation. Test only the final selection.
methods.inputs_zh: 父版训练中抽取失败与成功对照；两臂共用反馈长度上限和分析模型设置。
methods.inputs_en: Sample parent training failures and successful controls; both arms share a feedback-length cap and analysis-model settings.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 抽取训练证据并产生指定反馈
写候选与事前预测，运行原生评测
按原生规则选择，再核对预测
steps_en: Sample training evidence and generate the assigned feedback
Write a candidate and a prospective prediction; run native evaluation
Select under the native rule and compare prediction with outcomes
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 四场景已终测；Telecom仍无最终测试。每臂一次自适应搜索，后续父版自然分化，不是每轮固定同父版因果干预。
methods.limitations_en: Four benchmarks have final tests; Telecom does not yet. Each arm is one adaptive search with diverging parents, not repeated same-parent causal interventions.

methods.one_line_zh: 用问题分类、状态缺口、替代解释和可检验修复指导候选。
methods.one_line_en: Guide candidates with problem classes, state gaps, alternative explanations and testable repairs.
methods.change_zh: 在原生候选边界增加训练证据反馈；候选执行前记录预测。
methods.change_en: Add training-evidence feedback at the native candidate boundary; record a prediction before candidate execution.
methods.rule_zh: 继承本场景原生采用规则，不把新反馈自动视为L7验证门槛；测试仅最终报告。
methods.rule_en: Retain the benchmark’s native adoption rule; feedback does not implicitly add L7 validation. Test only the final selection.
methods.inputs_zh: 父版训练中抽取失败与成功对照；两臂共用反馈长度上限和分析模型设置。
methods.inputs_en: Sample parent training failures and successful controls; both arms share a feedback-length cap and analysis-model settings.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 抽取训练证据并产生指定反馈
写候选与事前预测，运行原生评测
按原生规则选择，再核对预测
steps_en: Sample training evidence and generate the assigned feedback
Write a candidate and a prospective prediction; run native evaluation
Select under the native rule and compare prediction with outcomes
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 四场景已终测；Telecom仍无最终测试。每臂一次自适应搜索，后续父版自然分化，不是每轮固定同父版因果干预。
methods.limitations_en: Four benchmarks have final tests; Telecom does not yet. Each arm is one adaptive search with diverging parents, not repeated same-parent causal interventions.

methods.one_line_zh: 监控、归因、优化三个外层职责。
methods.one_line_en: Monitoring, attribution and optimization as three outer-loop responsibilities.
methods.change_zh: 由会话与Skill指导训练、选簇、候选设计和晋升。
methods.change_en: Use sessions and Skills to guide evaluation, cluster choice, design and promotion.
methods.rule_zh: 按具体活动Target／Full及轮末晋升规则。
methods.rule_en: Use the specific campaign’s Target/Full and round-end promotion rules.
methods.inputs_zh: 对应活动的冻结父版、可见训练轨迹、角色/经验指令。
methods.inputs_en: The campaign’s frozen parent, visible training traces and role/experience instructions.
methods.editable_zh: 对应历史实例允许的YAML、提示、工具、记忆或Harness修改面；并非原生DSH插件统一空间。
methods.editable_en: The historical instance’s allowed YAML, prompt, tool, memory or harness surfaces; not a unified native-DSH plugin space.
steps_zh: 读取本实例协议
执行指定角色或程序化阶段
按原规则选择并单独报告测试
steps_en: Read the instance protocol
Execute the assigned roles or programmatic stages
Select under the original rule and report tests separately
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 三职责不等于三个执行插件；不预设多个常驻模型必然更好。
methods.limitations_en: Three responsibilities are not three runtime plugins; multiple persistent models are not established as necessary.

methods.one_line_zh: 把预算、阶段、冻结、调度与晋升交给程序。
methods.one_line_en: Program the budgets, stages, freezing, scheduling and promotion.
methods.change_zh: 保留模型诊断/设计，减少会话自行编排的不一致。
methods.change_en: Retain model diagnosis/design while reducing session-level orchestration inconsistencies.
methods.rule_zh: 原五轮、十轮、后续十五轮模板分别保留；不能混成同一选择规则。
methods.rule_en: Keep the original five-round, ten-round and later fifteen-round templates distinct.
methods.inputs_zh: 对应活动的冻结父版、可见训练轨迹、角色/经验指令。
methods.inputs_en: The campaign’s frozen parent, visible training traces and role/experience instructions.
methods.editable_zh: 对应历史实例允许的YAML、提示、工具、记忆或Harness修改面；并非原生DSH插件统一空间。
methods.editable_en: The historical instance’s allowed YAML, prompt, tool, memory or harness surfaces; not a unified native-DSH plugin space.
steps_zh: 读取本实例协议
执行指定角色或程序化阶段
按原规则选择并单独报告测试
steps_en: Read the instance protocol
Execute the assigned roles or programmatic stages
Select under the original rule and report tests separately
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 原五轮未终测，后来补测不能倒写为原活动终测；权威YAML是工程改进。
methods.limitations_en: The original five-round campaign had no final test; later testing must not be retroactively labeled its final evaluation. YAML authority is an engineering change.

methods.one_line_zh: 按问题类别或条件组织优化器知识。
methods.one_line_en: Organize optimizer knowledge by problem type or conditions.
methods.change_zh: 经历按类型、六维标签、条件式指导及经验开关诊断。
methods.change_en: Includes type-based, six-axis and conditional guidance, plus experience-on/off diagnostics.
methods.rule_zh: 经验只进入指定设计/修复阶段；探针、两题评测与完整搜索分别计量。
methods.rule_en: Provide experience only to the specified design/repair stages; distinguish probes, two-task evaluations and full search.
methods.inputs_zh: 对应活动的冻结父版、可见训练轨迹、角色/经验指令。
methods.inputs_en: The campaign’s frozen parent, visible training traces and role/experience instructions.
methods.editable_zh: 对应历史实例允许的YAML、提示、工具、记忆或Harness修改面；并非原生DSH插件统一空间。
methods.editable_en: The historical instance’s allowed YAML, prompt, tool, memory or harness surfaces; not a unified native-DSH plugin space.
steps_zh: 读取本实例协议
执行指定角色或程序化阶段
按原规则选择并单独报告测试
steps_en: Read the instance protocol
Execute the assigned roles or programmatic stages
Select under the original rule and report tests separately
methods.final_selection_zh: 按训练／验证规则锁定最终版，测试仅报告。
methods.final_selection_en: Seal the training/development-selected final checkpoint; use test only for reporting.
methods.limitations_zh: 修改偏好变化和输入送达不是稳定行为收益；既有经验对照起点不同，四组严格匹配方案未运行。
methods.limitations_en: Changed edit preferences and input delivery are not stable behavior gains. Existing comparisons had differing initial evidence; the matched four-arm design was not run.

methods.one_line_zh: 保留有互补能力的可执行组合，不只保留高分。
methods.one_line_en: Retain executable combinations with complementary capabilities, not only high scores.
methods.change_zh: 将冠军选择、机制解释与多样性保留分开。
methods.change_en: Separate champion selection, mechanism explanation and diversity retention.
methods.rule_zh: 尚未确定并实现新采用规则；不能报告为已验证算法。
methods.rule_en: No new selection algorithm has been implemented and established yet.
methods.inputs_zh: 拟使用当前失败、行为差异、组件组合与资源预算。
methods.inputs_en: Proposed inputs: current failures, behavior differences, component combinations and budgets.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 先定义互补性与资源约束
再与L3分支和L9组件作匹配比较
steps_en: Define complementarity and resource constraints
Compare against matched L3 branch and L9 component baselines
methods.final_selection_zh: 未运行，没有最终测试。
methods.final_selection_en: Not run; no final tests.
methods.limitations_zh: 不能把L3归档改名就算新增机制。
methods.limitations_en: Renaming the L3 archive does not constitute a new mechanism.

methods.one_line_zh: 从空插件起点出发，读取旧能力并改装组合。
methods.one_line_en: Start with empty plugins and adapt prior capabilities into combinations.
methods.change_zh: 显式提供历史插件来源，检验复用能否改善新组合。
methods.change_en: Provide prior plugins explicitly and test whether reuse improves a new combination.
methods.rule_zh: 保留该历史活动完整训练晋升规则，记录组合的共同效果。
methods.rule_en: Retain the historical full-training adoption rule and record the combination outcome.
methods.inputs_zh: 空插件基线、历史插件和可见训练证据。
methods.inputs_en: Empty-plugin baseline, prior plugins and visible training evidence.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 十轮训练选定版测试59.17%；不是独立组件消融。
methods.final_selection_en: The training-selected ten-round artifact tested at 59.17%; this is not an independent component ablation.
methods.limitations_zh: 可用组件相加不自动产生更强组合；复用具有历史信息成本。
methods.limitations_en: Adding available components does not automatically improve a combination; reuse has prior-information cost.

methods.one_line_zh: 比较空插件或已有插件，以及持续或重开会话。
methods.one_line_en: Compare empty or seeded plugins and persistent or restarted sessions.
methods.change_zh: 分别变化起点或会话保留方式，保留原角色模型及预算。
methods.change_en: Vary startpoint or session persistence while retaining the recorded model roles and budgets.
methods.rule_zh: 使用每个分支原有训练选择规则；不同起点不共享同一纵向单调曲线。
methods.rule_en: Use each arm’s original training selection rule; different starts do not form one monotonic evolution curve.
methods.inputs_zh: 指定初始产物、训练证据、模型与会话协议。
methods.inputs_en: Specified initial artifact, training evidence, model and session protocol.
methods.editable_zh: 本轮候选的插件与组合；数据、评分、做题模型、任务预算固定。
methods.editable_en: Candidate plugins and composition; keep data, scoring, actor and episode budgets fixed.
steps_zh: 在当前批次重新评测父版，读取失败及成功对照
生成并冻结候选，运行同批训练与配置要求的验证
比较实际输入／控制记录与成绩，记录采用或拒绝
steps_en: Evaluate the parent on the current batch; read failures and successful controls
Generate and freeze a candidate; run paired-batch training and configured validation
Check input/control evidence and scores; record acceptance or rejection
methods.final_selection_zh: 保留各分支按训练选择的终点，单列中途停止与后补测试。
methods.final_selection_en: Keep each training-selected endpoint; mark stopped arms and later tests separately.
methods.limitations_zh: 会话重开仍继承文件和代码，不等于没有历史知识；效应随起点变化。
methods.limitations_en: Restarted sessions still inherit files and code, so they are not history-free; effects depend on the startpoint.
